Harper J.: Massive shoutout to Zoe L. for racing across the floor to save the snack fridge when the door was stuck and handing out emergency granola bars during the town hall. You are a legend :raised_hands: :granola:
Zoe L.: lol I felt like a snack firefighter. Also, the fridge was held closed by a rogue sticky note and a stubborn magnet :fire_extinguisher:
Evan M.: Zoe 10; heroic. Saved my life, my presentation, and my afternoon sugar levels :sweat_smile:
Priya D.: Also shoutout for Zoes calm vibes while coordinating with facilities and ops. She texted them, fetched a toolkit, and mobilized the snack distribution like a pro :sparkles:
Harper J.: vote: what's the team reward? react :star: for sticker + kudos card, :cookie: for cookie delivery, :trophy: for small desk trophy. Poll open 24h
OpsBot: Poll opened by Harper J. react to vote. Poll will auto-close in 24 hours.
Zoe L.: :cookie: (I will accept cookies and slightly awkward confetti)
Evan M.: :star: (stickers forever)
Priya D.: :trophy: (desk trophies are unironically motivating)
Harper J.: adding to wins board and retro shoutouts. Zoe, we owe you cookies and a sticker at minimum. Thank you for the quick rescue :sparkling_heart:
